news.summary: Solana will reduce its slot times from 400ms to 200ms. This change will make the protocol more competitive in terms of latency. Here we explore some possible implication on validators economic.
news.title: Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic

news.summary: Reap moves roughly $6B a year in stablecoin card volume after building cross-border payments infrastructure from Asia.
news.title: Why Asia Is Ahead on Stablecoins, According to Reap's Daren Guo

news.summary: X402 has processed roughly 200M transactions and $50B in volume, giving AI agents a stablecoin-native way to pay for web resources.
news.title: Webinar Recap: Giving AI agents a native way to pay with x402

news.title: Transaction v1 and the ALT Trade-off

news.title: Inside Solana’s Growing Market for Tokenized Cards and Physical Collectibles
